faq.question: Q1. What is the organization conducting the ITDA Gumla recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: The recruitment process is conducted by the Integrated Tribal Development Agency Gumla (ITDA Gumla) in the state of Jharkhand for filling up various teaching vacancies.

faq.question: Q2. How many total vacancies are available under this notification?
faq.answer: A total of 20 vacancies have been announced for Trained Graduate Teacher (TGT) positions across different subjects including Hindi, English, Mathematics, Science, and Social Science.

faq.question: Q3. What is the mode of application for ITDA Gumla recruitment?
faq.answer: The mode of application is strictly offline. Interested candidates must fill out the prescribed application form and send it to the designated address via post or submit it as per guidelines before the deadline.

faq.question: Q4. What is the last date to submit the offline application form?
faq.answer: The last date for the receipt of the completed offline application form by the authorities is 06 October 2026. Candidates must ensure timely submission to avoid rejection.

faq.question: Q5. When is the walk-in interview scheduled for shortlisted candidates?
faq.answer: The walk-in interview and skill test for the ITDA Gumla TGT recruitment 2026 are scheduled to be conducted on 12 October 2026 at the specified venue.

faq.question: Q6. What is the educational qualification required for TGT posts?
faq.answer: Candidates must be graduates with a minimum of 50% marks in the relevant subject from a recognized institution, along with a B.Ed or 4-year integrated B.A.B.Ed degree, and CTET/STET qualification.

faq.question: Q7. What is the age limit for applicants?
faq.answer: The age limit ranges from a minimum of 21 years to a maximum of 60 years. Additionally, retired teachers up to the age of 65 years are also eligible for consideration.

faq.question: Q8. Is there any application fee for applying to these posts?
faq.answer: No, there is no application fee required for candidates belonging to General, OBC, SC, or ST categories. The application fee is Nil for all eligible applicants.

faq.question: Q9. What is the selection process for ITDA Gumla TGT positions?
faq.answer: The selection process comprises Document Verification, a Walk-in Interview, and a Skill Test to evaluate the candidates' proficiency and suitability for teaching roles.

faq.question: Q10. Where can I download the official notification and application form?
faq.answer: You can download the official notification PDF and access the application form details directly from the official website at www.gumla.nic.in or via the important links provided in this article.
